record.paper_title: Geometric and Topological Obstructions to Various Immersions in Submanifold Theory and Some Related Open Problems
record.original_question: What further topological and geometric obstructions prevent Riemannian manifolds from admitting Lagrangian immersions or slant immersions into complex Euclidean or flat Kahler ambient spaces, beyond the known obstruction results surveyed for those two classes of immersions?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.5. Find further topological and geometric obstructions to Lagrangian and slant immersions, besides those given in this section.
The next result from [15, 17] provides a Riemannian obstruction to slant immersions into flat Kahler manifolds.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\tilde M^{2n}, J, g, \omega)$ be a flat Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$ (in particular, the complex Euclidean space $\mathbb{C}^n$ with its standard Kähler structure). An isometric immersion $f: M^n \to \tilde M^{2n}$ of a Riemannian $n$-manifold is called Lagrangian if $f^*\omega = 0$, i.e. $J(f_*T_pM) = (f_*T_pM)^\perp$ for every $p \in M$. More generally, for a constant angle $\theta \in [0, \pi/2]$, an isometric immersion $f: M^k \to \tilde M^{2n}$ of a Riemannian $k$-manifold is called $\theta$-slant if for every $p \in M$ and every nonzero $X \in T_pM$, the angle between $J f_*X$ and $f_*(T_pM)$ equals $\theta$ (Lagrangian immersions correspond to $\theta = \pi/2$).

Known obstructions (of Riemannian, topological, or curvature-theoretic type, e.g. Chen-type $\delta$-invariant inequalities, Maslov-class restrictions, and constraints from the mean curvature) rule out many Riemannian manifolds from admitting such immersions into $\mathbb{C}^n$ or into a flat Kähler ambient space.

Problem. Find further topological and geometric obstructions (beyond the currently known ones) that prevent a Riemannian manifold $M$ from admitting:
(a) a Lagrangian isometric immersion into $\mathbb{C}^n$ (or, more generally, into a flat Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$), and
(b) a $\theta$-slant isometric immersion into $\mathbb{C}^n$ (or into a flat Kähler manifold) for some constant slant angle $\theta \in (0, \pi/2]$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is an open-ended research question asking for new obstructions to Lagrangian and slant isometric immersions into complex Euclidean / flat Kähler ambient spaces. Recent surveys and papers on δ-invariants and ideal Lagrangian immersions continue to uncover further Riemannian obstructions, but no comprehensive solution exists; the area remains active and the problem is open.

status_evidence.title: δ-Invariants, Inequalities of Submanifolds and Their Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Applies δ-invariants to obtain Riemannian obstructions to Lagrangian and slant isometric immersions into complex Euclidean spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Research on obstructions to Lagrangian/slant immersions remains active with new Riemannian obstructions being uncovered.

status_evidence.title: Riemannian Submanifolds: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses known obstructions and notes ongoing problems concerning Lagrangian and slant submanifolds of Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The general question of further obstructions is treated as a continuing open program.
